text.tspan: I am a Computer Science undergraduate with hands-on experience building full-stack applications,
backend systems, REST APIs, and AI-powered solutions. My work includes a placement automation
platform, an AI meeting assistant, a gesture-controlled robotics system, and a blockchain
platform that placed 5th at the PALS InnoWAH National Hackathon at IIT Madras.
I am currently strengthening my Python, backend development, data structures and algorithms, and
database skills. I am looking for software development internship and full-time opportunities
where I can build useful products and keep learning.
B.E. CSE, K.S.R. College of Engineering, Tiruchengode | CGPA 7.74 | 2027
Backend Developer, Python Developer, Full-Stack Developer, SDE Intern
